Loss report: gha -> tekton
[external] pipeline/ci/job/prod job.runner: no node selector (the hosted label ubuntu-latest runs on any Linux worker; the GitHub-hosted image tools are not present)
[external] pipeline/ci/job/test job.runner: no node selector (the hosted label ubuntu-latest runs on any Linux worker; the GitHub-hosted image tools are not present)
[external] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.push: Secret pipemaster-github-webhook (create the Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token holding the GitHub webhook secret; the github interceptor rejects a webhook that it does not sign)
[external] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 trigger.tag: Secret pipemaster-github-webhook (create the Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token holding the GitHub webhook secret; the github interceptor rejects a webhook that it does not sign)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/prod job.outputs: result step (an output with a value is written to its result file by the step pipemaster-outputs)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/prod step.workdir: shared working directory (the steps run in /workspace, the volume that Tekton mounts in every step; the source runs its steps in one shared directory)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/prod/step/prod-step-1 step.image: default image (the step names no image and Tekton requires one; alpine:3.22 runs it)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/prod/step/prod-step-1 step.shell: bash-if-present preamble in the script (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the script starts with a line that re-runs it under bash -e when the image has bash, else it runs under sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/test job.matrix: expanded combinations (exclude entries are applied by writing the remaining combinations as include entries)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/test/step/test-step-1 step.image: default image (the step names no image and Tekton requires one; alpine:3.22 runs it)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/test/step/test-step-1 step.shell: bash-if-present preamble in the script (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the script starts with a line that re-runs it under bash -e when the image has bash, else it runs under sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
